decision: G-WEBCHAT-AUTH (docs/release/assembly-dryrun-gaps.md): what a webchat consumer (a browser Human owning its Consumer) executes through the browser business authority snapshot (0045): open a conversation, write and read its messages, read a message's service receipt and scope denial (web_chat_http). Applied by nexloop_eios.webchat_consumers through the 0050 trusted configuration; only these consumer resources may ever appear (webchat_consumers.CONSUMER_RESOURCES).
